import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

        to_delete.append(r)
print('rows to delete:', to_delete)
for r in reversed(to_delete):
    ws.delete_rows(r)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
"
